m.s: Rinse {quinoa} well in a sieve, as it stops it tasting bitter. Simmer in a saucepan with twice its volume of salted water for 12 minutes until the little tails pop out. Take it off the heat, cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

Cut {chk_breast} into 3cm chunks and season with salt. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large deep frying pan over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 4 minutes. Set aside. It finishes cooking in the stew.

Turn the heat down to medium. Cook finely diced {onion} for 5 minutes until soft. Add crushed {garlic}, grated {ginger}, {cumin}, {cinnamon}, {smokedpaprika} and {turmeric}, and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add {tintom}, {chickpeas}, drained, {zucchini} in chunks, and {stockpowder} with ½ cup water for every 2 serves. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the chicken and simmer for 8 minutes more until it's cooked through (75°C). Finish with the juice of {lemon} and season with salt.
Serve over the quinoa with chopped {parsley} and a spoonful of {yoghurt}.

l: Freezes and reheats well. Pack the yoghurt separately. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the stock powder.
